evidence.observation: Growth held at 750±0.5 °C after initial settling; cooldown descending smoothly to 618.6 °C
Flow tracks setpoints (100 then 200 sccm), single 94.5 sccm blip at k=20
Stable ~3.05 Torr in growth, ~4.05 Torr at higher purge flow
Exhaust O2 remains 3-7 ppm throughout, no leak signature

args.missing_evidence: Post-run characterization (e.g., Raman/optical/AFM) of the sample to determine whether the target film grew
